status: PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE ANY HELDOUT EXECUTION (commit order is the evidence)

splits.validation: seeds 2000-2007 (selection among tuning top-3); further validation-split experiments use seeds 6000-7999
splits.heldout: seeds 3000-3019, split=heldout (N=15,G=5,tau=10,cv=0.7, different edge/vol/duration/cost ranges), scenarios S1..S12 + S5b

heldout_runs.H1_primary: 13 scenarios x 20 seeds x 12 policies + ORACLE_GREEDY_UB, K=4, primary ingest per frozen_params.json, cost belief known
heldout_runs.H2_ingest_matrix: 13 scenarios x 10 seeds (3000-3009) x all policies x 4 ingest modes, K=4 (descriptive; spam handling)
heldout_runs.H3_capacity_sweep: 13 scenarios x 10 seeds (3000-3009) x all policies, K in {3,4,6,10}, offered load fixed in absolute terms, params NOT retuned per K (descriptive only)

non_heldout_diagnostics: robustness OFAT, score-quality ladder, cost sensitivity, failure-mode battery, parameter-sensitivity grids are run on split=validation with fresh seeds, using frozen params
primary_metric: net_per_avail_slot_hour (bps of net outcome per available slot-hour = net_total/(K*W))
secondary_metrics_reported_separately_no: regret_vs_oracle_ub (oracle M1 - policy M1, paired by scenario/seed)
aggregation: per-scenario mean over seeds; macro-average over scenarios with equal weights; paired bootstrap (2000 resamples over seeds, seed-matched) for CIs
delta_rationale: INFERENCE: ~10% of typical FIFO M1 (1-3 bps/slot-hour) in this synthetic scale; not derived from any AurumShift quantity

rules.FIFO_FAILURE_SCENARIO_vs_raw_FIFO: scenario where >=1 of {SCORE_RANK,SLOTHOUR,SLOTHOUR_SHADOW,UNCERTAINTY_LCB,CORR_AWARE,LINTS} has paired CI_lower(M1 diff vs FIFO@RAW) > delta
rules.FIFO_FAILURE_SCENARIO_vs_FIFO_SCREEN: same, against FIFO_SCREEN at its frozen ingest (strong simple control)
rules.FIFO_EQUIVALENT_SCENARIO: no policy in that set has CI_lower > delta vs the reference FIFO variant (reported for both raw and strong variants)
rules.COMPLEXITY_JUSTIFIED: TRUE iff some COMPLEX method's macro paired diff vs the best SIMPLE method (by heldout macro M1) is > delta AND bootstrap CI_lower > 0 AND it has point-estimate win in >= 8/13 scenarios
rules.BEST_*_REFERENCE: SLOT_HOUR: argmax macro M1 among {SLOTHOUR,SLOTHOUR_SHADOW,SCORE_RANK}; DIVERSIFICATION: reported from S5/S5b/F_corr_collapse portfolio metrics (pnl_std,worst_24h,hhi_group,M1) without composite, choose by macro M1 among {CORR_AWARE vs SLOTHOUR pair} plus lowest worst-24h; TURNOVER: argmax M1 among {SLOTHOUR,SLOTHOUR_SHADOW,OLDEST_SLOT} reported with churn/idle
VERDICT: B = implementable methods beating FIFO@RAW with macro diff > delta and CI_lower > 0
T = methods whose macro M1 is within delta of the best implementable method; each member must win vs FIFO@RAW in >= 8/13 scenarios by point estimate else removed
no method (incl. FIFO) beats RANDOM@RAW by delta -> NO_CAPACITY_METHOD_SUPPORTED
any scientific invalidation (leak test failure, non-determinism) -> STUDY_INCONCLUSIVE

no_post_hoc_tuning: frozen_params.json sha256 recorded; heldout results are written once to results/heldout and never overwritten
cap_disclaimer: cap sweep is descriptive synthetic sensitivity; NO production cap recommendation is made or implied
